text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! It's almost time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship is finally, finally
here! I
finally get to race against Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I've been waiting for this day ever since
I first
heard about Oguri! Or wait...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Maybe I've been waiting since even before that! Huh, when did I start looking forward to today anyway? Eh, who cares!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna make this the best
race ever!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(This is gonna be a race like no one's
ever seen
before! It'll seriously be the
red-hot battle, just
like...)

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
And then what happened?! How'd you
take on
your rival, Dad?!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
I wanna hear more about your fiery
battle!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! Now, there I was,
face-to-face with my
rival...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I want people to talk about this race
with that
same look in their eyes Dad
had!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I want people to watch and get inspired
to follow
their own dreams!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's the kinda hot-blooded,
passionate race I'm
gonna deliver!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited to find out who the real
Ruler of
the Mile is between Oguri Cap
and Bamboo
Memory!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I am too, but let's be real. Oguri's definitely the strongest even when it comes to miles! This is her era, after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Can't argue with you there. Just look at
her! She's
in perfect shape today. She's
got it in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Today, we find out whether Bamboo's
dream
shines bright enough to redefine
the generation.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And as part of that generation, we
must bear
witness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Bamboo! We're all rooting
for you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It just hit me that my dream is waiting for
me out
there... It's kind of a weird
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And... there's something I have to tell
you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You've always believed in my dream and
me.
Your guidance is what has let me to
this point.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: THANK YOU FOR EVERYTHING!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now, my rival and I are going to put on a
race so
amazing that it lives on in the
hearts of everyone
who sees it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Today, my dream comes true!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: BUUUURN BRIGHT!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri! Are you ready to bring the
HEAT?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yup. Let's have a great race.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heck yeah!
